newsitem.title: USA: Trinity says to acquire some assets of Ladish Co.
newsitem.headline: Trinity says to acquire some assets of Ladish Co.

text.p: Trinity Industries Inc said on Friday that its Fitting and Flange subsidiary had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire some assets of the Industrial Products Division of Ladish Co Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, and Trinity said government approvals were pending.
Ladish Industrial Products Division manufactures pipeline fittings and flanges, corrosion-resistant valves and forgings.

Trinity Industries, with headquarters in Dallas, Texas, manufactures and markets a variety of products principally in three business segments: Transportation Products, Construction Products and Industrial Products.
